TERMS AND CONDITIONS
a) Governors’ Aviation reserves the right to make certain common-sense changes to routes if loads, weather, or other key factors dictate. We reserve the right to drop clients for Amboseli at
Kimana and vice versa. Passengers booking a return flight from Nairobi to Amboseli/Kimana may be routed via the Masai Mara at the company’s sole discretion. Similarly, for clients booked
to fly Amboseli/Kimana to Masai Mara, we reserve the right to return them to Nairobi and put them on the Nairobi to Mara flight, should loads dictate this.
b) All our flights to the Masai Mara operate with a minimum of 2 passengers all year round. The rest of our Amboseli/Kimana flights operate with a minimum of 4 passengers in High Season and
a minimum of 5 passengers in Mid and Low Season.
c) Due to the nature of safari flying, this flight may not route directly as indicated in the ticket but stop via other scheduled destinations.
d) This flight may be routed via Nairobi, particularly in the Mid and Low Seasons.
e) If load factors or other circumstances require it, we reserve the right to re-book passengers onto an equivalent airline or service.
Airstrips Accessed in each area:
Mara: Musiara, Kichwa, Mara Serena, Keekorok, Olkiombo, Ol Seki Naboisho, Olare Oroke, Cotters, Ol Kurruk / Angama, Ngerende and Mara North
Naivasha: Loldia
Amboseli: Amboseli and Kimani
Additional Notes
1. One rate for high and low season for all routes, with the exception of the flight route (Wilson / Mara / Wilson)
2. Child rates are applicable from 02 to 15 years.
3. A 10% discount will be applied if 3 or more flights are booked with Governors Aviation in same itinerary - not applicable to the return options
4. We offer daily flights between Nairobi Wilson airport and Loldia,and Masai Mara and charter flights throughout the region. Please contact us for assistance with reservations if necessary.
5. Terms and conditions for flights are contained in a separate document called “Flight Terms and Conditions” which can be found here
<https://governorscamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/20210101-Governors-Aviation-Flight-Terms-and-Conditions.pdf>
6. Guests should refer to that document for detailed terms and conditions relating to flights per point 5 above.
FUEL SURCHARGE: FUEL PRICES IN EAST AFRICA ARE CLOSELY LINKED TO THE INTERNATIONAL PRICE OF CRUDE OIL. IF FUEL PRICES INCREASE SIGNIFICANTLY THEN A FUEL
SURCHARGE WILL BE LEVIED TO COVER FOR THIS INCREASE. THIS WILL BE COMMUNICATED TO YOU IN ADVANCE.
It is a condition of travel with Wilderness/Governors' Collection that guests have travel insurance. Should they not have insurance cover, they will be personally responsible for any costs incurred as a result of a medical emergency or evacuation, as
well as any other insurance claim situation such as loss of luggage.
